name: Gear
author: Sixth Front
description: Built in and always on: the GEAR shop (main menu and deploy screen) sells heat vision and camouflage suits for the Career's silver. Heat vision (N, or HEAT on touch screens) gives 12 seconds of thermal sight with every soldier white-hot, then recharges; a suit changes your sleeves and makes the bots spot you from less far away (a ghillie suit most of all crouched or lying down).

#gr-heat-hud { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: calc(64px + var(--safe-t)); transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
font: 700 0.7rem var(--font-ui); letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px #000; pointer-events: none; z-index: 5; }
#gr-heat-hud i { display: block; width: 90px; height: 5px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); position: relative; }
#gr-heat-hud i s { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; background: #fff; }
#gr-heat-hud.charging { color: var(--muted); } #gr-heat-hud.charging i s { background: var(--muted); }
#menu-gear { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(13,16,18,0.96), rgba(13,16,18,0.9)); padding: calc(28px + var(--safe-t)) 40px calc(28px + var(--safe-b)); overflow-y: auto; }
.gr-wrap { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.gr-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding-bottom: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.gr-head h2 { margin: 2px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 900; font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 6vw, 3.2rem); letter-spacing: 0.05em; line-height: 0.95; }
.gr-bank { text-align: right; } .gr-bank span { display: block; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.24em; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; }
.gr-bank b { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 1.9rem; color: var(--signal); font-weight: 600; }
.gr-wrap h3 { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.24em; color: var(--muted); }
.gr-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 9px; }

.gr-card { appearance: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); padding: 11px 12px; color: var(--text); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; min-height: 96px; }
.gr-card b { font-size: 0.9rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.gr-card b i { width: 18px; height: 18px; display: inline-block; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); }
.gr-card em { font-style: normal; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--signal); margin-top: auto; }
.gr-card.owned em { color: var(--text); } .gr-card.on { border-color: var(--squad); background: rgba(124,227,91,0.1); } .gr-card.on em { color: var(--squad); }
.gr-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 10px; }
.gr-foot p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.74rem; color: var(--muted); max-width: 700px; line-height: 1.4; }
